All factors in one table

Source: R/all_factors.R
all_factors.Rd

Returns the package's factor datasets in a single long-format table.

all_factors(sources = c("french", "stambaugh"))

Arguments

sources

Character vector of source names to include: `"french"` (the shipped fama_french dataset) and/or `"stambaugh"` (the shipped stambaugh dataset). Defaults to both. An unknown source name is an error.

Value

A data.table with columns `source`, `region`, `frequency`, `factor`, `period` and `value`, in that order. `source` is `"French"` or `"Stambaugh"`. French rows come first, then Stambaugh, regardless of the order of `sources`. All columns are character except `value` (numeric); `fama_french`'s factor columns are coerced to character.

Details

Stambaugh rows are labelled `region = "US"`: both Stambaugh papers build their factors from US stocks (ordinary common shares on NYSE/AMEX/NASDAQ, CRSP), verified against the papers; see stambaugh. `market` and `risk free rate` are shared names across sources and mean the same thing. Other factors keep distinct names (French `SMB` and Stambaugh `size`, for example, are different constructions) and are told apart by `source`. `period` stays character in each source's own format (`YYYYMM`, `YYYYMMDD` or `YYYY`); the formats are comparable across sources. Both datasets ship with the package, so there is no runtime dependency on FFresearch.

Examples

all_factors()
#>            source region frequency factor   period    value
#>            <char> <char>    <char> <char>   <char>    <num>
#>      1:    French     US     month    CMA   196307 -1.15000
#>      2:    French     US     month    CMA   196308 -0.38000
#>      3:    French     US     month    CMA   196309  0.15000
#>      4:    French     US     month    CMA   196310 -2.25000
#>      5:    French     US     month    CMA   196311  2.27000
#>     ---                                                    
#> 671309: Stambaugh     US       day market 20161223  0.00191
#> 671310: Stambaugh     US       day market 20161227  0.00271
#> 671311: Stambaugh     US       day market 20161228 -0.00869
#> 671312: Stambaugh     US       day market 20161229 -0.00039
#> 671313: Stambaugh     US       day market 20161230 -0.00519
all_factors("stambaugh")
#>           source region frequency               factor   period       value
#>           <char> <char>    <char>               <char>   <char>       <num>
#>     1: Stambaugh     US     month non-traded liquidity   196208  0.00425841
#>     2: Stambaugh     US     month non-traded liquidity   196209  0.01112344
#>     3: Stambaugh     US     month non-traded liquidity   196210 -0.07388795
#>     4: Stambaugh     US     month non-traded liquidity   196211  0.02812444
#>     5: Stambaugh     US     month non-traded liquidity   196212  0.01495171
#>    ---                                                                     
#> 72663: Stambaugh     US       day               market 20161223  0.00191000
#> 72664: Stambaugh     US       day               market 20161227  0.00271000
#> 72665: Stambaugh     US       day               market 20161228 -0.00869000
#> 72666: Stambaugh     US       day               market 20161229 -0.00039000
#> 72667: Stambaugh     US       day               market 20161230 -0.00519000
